card.name: Colon after drug-class heading
card.fires_on: The colon or bracket right after a drug-class or condition heading in an interaction or dosing list, such as 'Anticoagulants, oral' or 'Amebiasis, Intestinal'. Also the end of a qualifier like 'NOS' after a lymphoma name.
